lessonTitle: 4. Product of monomials, powers with natural exponents
lessonTitleEnglish: Product of monomials, powers with natural exponents
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: aⁿ is the product of n factors equal to a; a is the base and n the exponent; a¹ = a.
stages.headlineEnglish: aⁿ is the product of n factors equal to a; a is the base and n the exponent; a¹ = a.

stages.headline: Multiplying powers with the same base adds exponents; raising a power to a power multiplies them.
stages.headlineEnglish: Multiplying powers with the same base adds exponents; raising a power to a power multiplies them.

stages.headline: To multiply monomials, multiply the coefficients and the powers of each letter separately.
